// about: Enterprise profile template. `bin/reactory-repos enterprise init <name>` copies this folder to enterprises/<name>/ (its own git repo, gitignored in the workspace) and replaces example-enterprise / Example Enterprise with the name.
name: example-enterprise
// primary_org: Org that `origin` points at in every repo. Usually the upstream; set to the mirror key for machines that must only talk to the enterprise org.
// include_groups: Inventory groups (repos.json) that are mirrored into this enterprise. Everything else is treated as upstream-only.
// include_repos: Single inventory repos mirrored although their group is not (a service the platform calls, say). `exclude_repos` wins over both includes. Names must exist in repos.json.

acme.// merge: merge_strategy: how sync/import PRs land (merge-commit keeps the cross-org ancestry; never squash). pr_merge_method: how feature and seed PRs land (squash). auto_merge: arm GitHub auto-merge on PRs the tool opens, so they merge when review + checks pass and the head branch is deleted (needs allow_auto_merge + delete_branch_on_merge on the repo). cleanup_branch_prefixes: branches `cleanup` deletes once merged.
acme.// org_specific_paths: Files that belong to this org only. On every sync the target org's version wins; if the target has no such file it is removed. Add every file your org injects into repos.
acme.// provisioning: Optional. `provision --to acme` renders one template per mirrored repo into fragments for your repo-management system.

provisioning.// template: Paths are relative to this enterprise repo first, then to the workspace.

// extra_repos: Repos that exist only in this enterprise (its own modules / tenant configs). `org` names the key above; `no_repo: true` marks a folder that has no remote yet.

extra_repos.name: acme-tenant
extra_repos.description: Enterprise tenant configuration for the Reactory server
